name: Shrihari Gokulachandran
title: Digital Design Engineer
bio: I'm a Digital Design Engineer with experience designing AI/ML accelerator hardware, memory controllers, and low-power digital IPs.

At Silicon Labs, I serve as the sole architect and RTL designer for an early-stage edge ML inference accelerator IP — owning the full path from workload profiling and NPU benchmarking to microarchitecture definition and RTL implementation, including SystemVerilog RTL design, architectural modeling, workload-driven design exploration, and hardware/software co-design.

My research focuses on workload-driven power management and synthesis optimization for heterogeneous systems; related work on dynamic voltage, body-bias, and frequency scaling for FD-SOI low-power edge processors appears at DATE 2026.

I also have end-to-end RTL-to-GDS experience and post-silicon bring-up of a TSMC 65nm compute-near-memory MPW test chip, and I build agentic interfaces between LLMs and EDA tools to automate RTL design, verification, and debug.
